hierarchy_note: Higher entries win. CMS-4201-F: MA plans may not apply internal criteria or MCG more restrictively than Traditional Medicare NCD/LCD/regulation.
covered_cpt_note: The criteria apply ONLY to the services listed under `procedures`. Any other billing code has no entry here: the engine refuses to score it against another service's rules and shows 'no policy yet'.
